description: Lantern's ESSENTIAL RULES, tested — a regression guard
not_checked: rule 4 — paper mode is the honored fallback whenever no camera resolves. A behaviour under a condition this reader cannot create. A hand proves it; 'nothing may obstruct the viewfinder' deserves an eye, not a substring.
note: A guard's value is the day it fires, not the day it passes.

guards.law: Android: all four sql:allow-* capabilities · no non-ASCII SQL DEFAULTs

Camera: NO custom Kotlin plugin (Tauri v2's generated RustWebChromeClient.kt already grants CAMERA for VIDEO_CAPTURE); extras sync via npm run sync-android, wired into beforeDevCommand/beforeBuildCommand
guards.custom_kotlin_found: none  [correct — its ARRIVAL is the failure]
guards.note: A negative rule: this guard watches for the plugin's ARRIVAL, not its absence. gen/ is excluded — Tauri's own generated Kotlin is expected and is not a custom plugin.

guards.law: opacity is a comfort control, not a difficulty setting — no scores, no streaks, no shame mechanics
guards.note: A promise about what this app will never do to its user, tested as an ABSENCE — the only honest way to test one. A hit is a question for a hand, not proof: a word can appear in a comment or a variable that means something else.

guards.law: icons re-applied from resonance-assets/logo-icons/lantern.png after any tauri android init (gen/android can silently revert them)
guards.note: Reaches into a sibling repo. If the source is not visible from here this reader reports that it could not see it — never that the icon is wrong.
